sources.title: NASA data sources
sources.purpose: Bring satellite and weather measurements into SoilMate. These product names appear in the supplied data, but the project does not yet download them.
inputs: NASA POWER: weather and atmospheric fields
outputs: Future raw measurements for the data pipeline
sources.notes: Product names are recorded in CSV freshness fields and project notes. Live integration, product versions and coverage are not verified. Keep credentials on the server; no credentials are included here.

ingest.title: Import measurements
ingest.purpose: Fetch selected products and keep the original downloads. The script is currently empty.
inputs: Selected location, time range and NASA products
outputs: Proposed raw files and source dates
ingest.notes: No scheduled job, downloader, raw-data folder or live refresh is implemented. HDF4 and other product-specific formats may require extra readers.

clean.title: Prepare and check data
clean.purpose: Proposed step: clean dates, match locations, join measurements, and prepare the files used by the app.
inputs: Future raw weather and satellite data
clean.notes: The script is empty. No automated lineage from NASA products to the existing CSVs is demonstrated. Validate units, cloud gaps and risk rules before generating statuses.

forecast.title: Forecast future risk
forecast.purpose: An optional future forecasting branch. It is separate from the current Simulation panel.
outputs: Future forecast values and evaluation results
forecast.notes: The forecasting script is empty and models/ has no model artifacts. No current route runs a model or returns predictions.

snapshots.title: Weather and risk files
snapshots.purpose: Local CSV files supply the weather card, four risk cards and the soil scene.
inputs: weather.csv: temperature, condition, humidity, rain, wind
LayerRisk.csv: supplied risk values, statuses and scene data
outputs: Rows matching the requested state and date
snapshots.notes: These are supplied local datasets. The app reads reported statuses rather than computing new drought classifications. Current code does not prove their upstream NASA lineage.

geodata.title: Map data and boundaries
geodata.purpose: Combine state-level risk categories with Malaysia state shapes.
inputs: maps_data.csv: alert, rain, humidity, soil and plant categories
outputs: Map categories joined to state shapes for a selected date
geodata.notes: The map uses the selected date and shows all states. State names are normalised, including Melaka/Malacca and Pulau Pinang/Penang.

history.title: Daily history files
history.purpose: Four CSVs hold summary rows and daily chart observations.
outputs: Daily history for the chart window
history.notes: The reader handles the extra header row and row offsets in these files. Missing days stay as gaps; values and reported statuses are preserved.

server.title: FastAPI and page rendering
server.purpose: Receive browser requests, read matching data and render pages or HTML fragments using Jinja templates.
inputs: Optional weeks value for the soil scene
Local weather and risk CSV rows
server.notes: The app is a server-rendered FastAPI application. Uvicorn is the declared ASGI runner. /simulation moves backwards from the chosen date; it is not a future forecast.

mapengine.title: Build interactive maps
mapengine.purpose: Folium builds a Leaflet map for the selected date and colours the state shapes using supplied categories.
mapengine.notes: The routes generate map HTML on request. The HTML files in dashboard/maps/ are standalone saved map outputs, not the live route data source. Folium defaults can load map tiles and browser assets from external providers.

analysis.title: Prepare chart data
analysis.purpose: Read the four history files, match the state and date, and build Plotly chart specifications.
outputs: GET /analysis: summaries, chart JSON and daily-data tables
analysis.notes: The in-memory cache refreshes when a source file changes. Rain summary totals always cover 14 days, even when the plot shows 30 or 90 days. ESI scale and status cutoffs still need domain review.

overview.title: Overview dashboard
overview.purpose: Help a grower see the chosen state and date at a glance.
outputs: Four risk cards: rain, air, soil, plants
overview.notes: Simulation shows a soil image band from stored soil values. Week controls select earlier dates. The motion button only changes the visual animation.

mapui.title: Five map layers
mapui.purpose: Explore Malaysia by switching between five state-coloured maps.
inputs: Folium-generated map HTML in an iframe
outputs: Alert, rain, air dryness, soil and plant views
Pan, zoom and click-to-zoom on state shapes
mapui.notes: Changing the date or layer reloads the iframe. Selecting a state changes the weather, risk and scene cards; it does not currently filter the map to that one state. The source column named Humidity is displayed as the air-dryness map layer.

charts.title: Monitoring and Analysis
charts.purpose: Show trends and the underlying observations in simple charts.
inputs: Plotly chart JSON and summary values from /analysis
outputs: Rainfall balance, dry-air pressure, root-zone moisture and plant response
Chart view switches, zoom reset and daily-data dialogs
charts.notes: Desktop supports drag-to-zoom. Touch devices keep page scrolling and tap tooltips. Charts preserve missing observations and show a note about ESI interpretation.

browser.title: Grower in a web browser
browser.purpose: Choose a Malaysian state and a date, then open Overview or Monitoring and Analysis.
inputs: State, date, chart period and map-layer choices
outputs: Visible cards, maps, charts and daily-data tables
browser.notes: Pages share state/date controls. Overview updates fragments with fetch; Analysis uses page requests. No login, database, production hosting setup or background scheduler is demonstrated in the inspected source.
